tiers.T1: A dedicated tool does the operation.
tiers.T2: Reachable through a generic tool, with a recipe that was run and checked.
tiers.T3: Documented. Not opened as a tool, or reachable only through a generic tool without a verified recipe.

reasons.chemscript.interop: SWIG and native interop plumbing; not part of the SDK's API and never exposed.
reasons.chemscript.collection: Generated collection wrapper; reached through the property of its owning type.
reasons.chemscript.unverified: Reachable through execute_chemscript_sdk; no recipe has been run for this member yet.
reasons.com.default: No generic COM tool yet; the existing tools use only the members listed as T1.
reasons.com.enum: Enumeration of constants used as arguments to COM members.
reasons.com.coclass: Class identifier that creates the interfaces listed beside it.
reasons.menu.default: No tool runs menu commands on Windows yet.
reasons.cdxml.default: Documented element; no tool reads or writes it through a typed model yet.
reasons.cdxml.unconfirmed: Name from the CDXML format with no evidence in this installation.
